title: Live mainnet CurveAMMAdapter 0x2D02…D6f runs the pre-story-052 setRoute validator: a gapped USDe->sUSDe route set by the owner is accepted, and every subsequent USDe deposit is silently and permanently stranded as crvUSD in the immutably-bound live market strategy
description: story-052 (4788ed4) added a route-contiguity validator to CurveAMMAdapter.setRoute (HEAD :96-143), Halmos-proven at HEAD for S1-S4 over an unbounded domain. The live USDe market strategy YieldStrategyUSDe 0xaC2e5936Eca286eC364d4D5Bcca33145fBe57f95 holds an IMMUTABLE ammAdapter (ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy.sol:34) pointing at the non-proxy CurveAMMAdapter 0x2D024e0d03Fb6Ead4F8E7Ba1EBECF6db0E755D6f, which was deployed before story-052 and still runs the legacy validator (== cdd0743 code). Any future owner setRoute on 0x2D02 therefore still accepts the sya-harvester M-01 gapped-route shape. A competent owner reading HEAD source would believe setRoute rejects such routes on mainnet: that surprise is the Law-3 footgun.
impact: Deposit direction (USDe->sUSDe): SILENT, PERMANENT strand. Router NG stops at the first gap and delivers the intermediate crvUSD to the strategy. _acquireShares checks the router's return against minOut = convertToShares(creditedPrincipal), which is denominated in sUSDe SHARES (794.28 for a 1000 USDe deposit); ~1001 crvUSD clears it. The strategy trusts the router return, records it as sharesReceived, credits principal, and emits a normal-looking Deposited event; it never measures its sUSDe balance. Fork PoC (block ~26288088, live 0x2D02 + 0xaC2e…7f95): 1000 USDe deposit by V2 -> getTotalShares unchanged (5162.3388), 1001.0035 crvUSD stranded, V2 principal +997 but backing +506.14 (V2 under-backed 490.86), co-client balances -506.14 (diluted), strategy deficit (totalDeposited - positionValue) 994.74. No exit path: full selector enumeration finds no sweep/rescue; emergencyWithdraw moves only vault shares; skimSurplus/totalWithdrawal/depositAsOwner cannot move crvUSD (test_L30_strandedCrvUSDHasNoExitPath, L30ValidatorProbe). The loss is socialised across the commingled position and reaches V2 stakers as under-backed principal / Antimatter-phUSD dilution, and trips V2's _isUnderwater guard. Withdraw direction (sUSDe->USDe): REVERTS, but only because the strategy holds 0 idle USDe ('ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance' on the forward transfer to V2) — availability loss until the route is overwritten. Today: None at present — 2 RouteSet logs on 0x2D02 (blocks 25283690/25283691), both contiguous.
attackPath: Owner footgun, not an attacker path. A non-malicious owner calls setRoute(USDe, sUSDe, [USDe, P1, crvUSD, 0, sUSDe, 0...]) on the live adapter 0x2D02 (the sya-harvester M-01 dropped-pool-slot shape), believing HEAD's story-052 validator protects mainnet.
The legacy validator on 0x2D02 accepts it (HEAD would revert InvalidRouteGap(4)); test_L30_liveAcceptsGappedRoute_headRejects.

A client (live: StableStakerV2 0xA6d3…B58F) deposits 1000 USDe into YieldStrategyUSDe 0xaC2e…7f95; _acquireShares calls ammAdapter.swap with minOut = convertToShares(creditedPrincipal) = 794.28 (share-denominated).

Router NG stops at the gap and transfers ~1001.0035 crvUSD to the strategy, returning that amount; 1001 > 794.28 so the floor passes; the strategy records it as sharesReceived and credits principal. Deposited event looks normal.

getTotalShares is unchanged; the crvUSD has no exit path in the strategy; every further deposit while the route is stored strands the same way. The deficit is socialised across co-clients (test_L30_gappedDepositSilentlyStrandsCrvUSD).
Reverse direction: a gapped sUSDe->USDe route makes withdraw revert ('ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance') because the strategy holds 0 idle USDe (test_L30_gappedWithdrawRouteReverts).
evidence: Invariant mutant control MutantCurveAMMAdapterLegacy (cdd0743 validator == live code): S1-S4 + storedRoutesValid FAIL on forge and medusa (reports/18/tier3-raw/forge-route-invariant.txt, medusa-route.txt).
Halmos legacy mutant violates S1-S4 (reports/18/tier3-raw/halmos-setroute-mutant-legacy-bounded-S1.txt, -S2S4.txt); HEAD PASS (halmos-setroute-real.txt). PASS applies to HEAD only.
On-chain: 2 RouteSet logs on 0x2D02 (blocks 25283690/25283691), both contiguous; first-party setRoute callers enumerated in phStaging2 @ d0060cb.

Coded fork PoC work/test/poc-run18-L30-LiveAdapterGappedRouteStrand.t.sol: 5/5 PASS, independently re-run per test by poc-validator (reports/18/poc/L-30-validate.txt, L-30-forge.txt); exit-path probe test/scan-run18/L30ValidatorProbe.t.sol 4/4 PASS.
severity-auditor (reports/18/severity-audit.json): Medium, flagForHuman; validity/poc-validator: facts agreed, rated Low (owner-action precondition).
knownIssueNote: src/CLAUDE.md mentions that the live adapter predates the check; that is documentation, not a Known Issue (0 KIs, no suppression authority).
recommendation: (a) Redeploy the adapter with the HEAD (story-052) validator. ammAdapter is immutable on the strategy (ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy.sol:34), so this means redeploying the strategy too, or migrating clients to a new strategy bound to the new adapter.

(b) Until then, every mainnet setRoute payload for 0x2D02 must be dry-run on a fork against the HEAD validator (or validated off-chain against S1-S4) before broadcast, and this requirement must be added to the phStaging2 runbook (where setRoute calls originate).

(c) Defence in depth: measure vault.balanceOf(this) before/after the swap in _acquireShares and use the measured delta as sharesReceived (and/or measure the output-token balance delta in the adapter's swap) — links L-12 6e771a84e82d (return-value trust).
(d) Make the routeGap test enumerate AMMRoutes.json keys via vm.parseJsonKeys(json, '.Curve.RouterNG.routes') rather than two hard-coded keys (absorbs F-06 7ef86352a3dd).
safeConfigGuidance: Before any setRoute on 0x2D02, validate the route off-chain against S1-S4 (or redeploy the adapter and strategy).
escalationTrigger: Re-weigh toward HIGH if any RouteSet beyond the 2 known appears on 0x2D02 with a payload failing S1-S4 while deposits are live: the strand is then realised, not hypothetical (severity-auditor: 'stored route fails S1-S4' is already High-impact).
Downgrade to Low only by human triage (precondition is an owner setRoute not yet taken; poc-validator's position).
Prior Low-era triggers (superseded by the promotion): MEDIUM if any RouteSet beyond the 2 known appears without recorded off-chain validation, or a stored route fails S1-S4.
disclose: L-07 b28e77daefb3 (code-level half; this is the deployment-state half)
sya-harvester M-01 (same gapped-route strand class, Medium)
severityRationale: Medium (borderline, owner triage): severity-auditor fork-proved the deposit direction silently and permanently strands user deposits as crvUSD (1001.0035 crvUSD per 1000 USDe; V2 under-backed 490.86, co-clients diluted 506.14, strategy deficit 994.74; no recovery path by full selector enumeration); poc-validator agreed on the facts but rated Low because the precondition is a future owner setRoute on the pre-052 live adapter. Orchestrator chose Medium under Law 1 (recall beats tidiness) and consistency with sya-harvester M-01 (same class, Medium). Human may downgrade.
priorImpact: None at present: the full RouteSet history on 0x2D02 is exactly two events (blocks 25283690 / 25283691), both contiguous, passing every HEAD check, i/j matching pool coins, no self-pairs. If a future gapped route is stored, Router NG stops at the first gap: USDe strategy deposit/withdraw/skim revert (availability) or an intermediate token is delivered, until overwritten.
priorAttackPath: The owner reads HEAD source and believes setRoute enforces contiguity.
The owner sets a new route on the live adapter 0x2D02 without off-chain validation against the story-052 rule.
The legacy validator accepts the gapped route.
Strategy swaps revert or mis-deliver until the route is overwritten.
priorRecommendation: Before any mainnet setRoute on 0x2D02…D6f, dry-run the payload against HEAD CurveAMMAdapter.setRoute on a fork (or validate off-chain against S1-S4), or redeploy adapter+strategy. Note in src/CLAUDE.md and the phStaging2 runbook that the live adapter predates the validator.
